title: Getting started
text:
Welcome to read-spx
Within our lab we need to deal with X-Ray Fluorescence spectral data files produced by an Bruker Artax instrument. These files contain XML code that we need to parse.
This tiny Python package is developed to read these files into tabular data for easy subsequent data processing and plotting.
